decisions.ask: A change to the loans module that I did not make sits in the app root, so this task's commit is held.

recommended.door: You commit or stash your loans change, then I commit only the two files this task wrote, the late-fee code and its test.
recommended.why: The app root held nothing pending before the task, so the loans change is yours, and committing the root would carry it in unasked.
recommended.reverses_if: you say the loans change belongs to this task.

others.what_it_does: You say the loans change belongs to this task, and I commit it with the task's two files.

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; the task's two files stay uncommitted and your loans change stays as it is.
